name: aurora-ribbons
prompt: Make a shader layer with slow aurora ribbons drifting across a dark sky. Give me sliders for speed and ribbon count and a color picker for the glow.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer with slow aurora ribbons over a dark, starry sky. Each ribbon has a sharp lower edge and a vertical curtain that fades upward, shifting toward violet at the top. The controls are uSpeed (0–1, default 0.15), uCount (1–8 ribbons, default 4) and a uGlow color picker (default #3DFFB0). Fractional uCount values fade the last ribbon in or out, so keyframes look smooth. I haven't compiled or rendered it because no Powermove tools were attached to this run.
